animal_salida_coherente.name: animal_salida_coherente
animal_salida_coherente.value:
(
        "herd"."animal"."active" = true
        and "herd"."animal"."exit_reason" is null
        and "herd"."animal"."exit_known_on" is null
        and "herd"."animal"."exit_note" is null
        and "herd"."animal"."exit_evidence_id" is null
      ) or (
        "herd"."animal"."active" = false
        and "herd"."animal"."exit_reason" is not null
        and "herd"."animal"."exit_known_on" is not null
      )

parentage_parents_differ.name: parentage_parents_differ
parentage_parents_differ.value: "herd"."parentage_record"."dam_id" is null or "herd"."parentage_record"."sire_id" is null or "herd"."parentage_record"."dam_id" <> "herd"."parentage_record"."sire_id"

weighing_line_forma_valida.name: weighing_line_forma_valida
weighing_line_forma_valida.value:
(
        "growth"."weighing_line"."result" = 'weighed'
        and "growth"."weighing_line"."kilos" is not null
        and "growth"."weighing_line"."quality" in ('measured', 'observed', 'declared')
        and "growth"."weighing_line"."version" >= 1
      ) or (
        "growth"."weighing_line"."result" = 'gap'
        and "growth"."weighing_line"."kilos" is null
        and "growth"."weighing_line"."quality" is null
        and "growth"."weighing_line"."version" is null
        and "growth"."weighing_line"."evidence_id" is null
      )
